capability.summary: Coding-oriented reasoning model with a later documented knowledge cutoff.
capability.problem_space: Coding model for repository changes and tool-assisted software development. Applicable tasks include repository navigation, multi-file code changes, debugging, test implementation, code review. Accepts text, image input and produces text output. External tools are required to execute programs, browse sources, or modify files; generated instructions alone do not perform those actions. Published distinction: The native product is optimized for tool-assisted coding with a 400,000-token context and an August 2025 knowledge cutoff. This identifies documented coverage, not a guaranteed improvement on a particular repository.
